sources.title: granite-4.2-8b: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview granite-4.2-8b is an 8-billion-parameter, decoder-only dense Transformer reasoning model developed by IBM's ibm-granite team. It uses the GraniteForCausalLM architecture, runs through the Transformers ecosystem, and generates text from conversational or instruction prompts. Its defining feature is native <think>...</think> reasoning, with full-thinking, non-thinking, and low-effort ...
